vehicles.name: IRC Class A train of vehicles
vehicles.notes: 8-axle train, total 554 kN. Axle loads 27/27/114/114/68/68/68/68 kN at 1.10/3.20/1.20/4.30/3.00/3.00/3.00 m. Wheel gauge 1.80 m c/c. Ground contact 0.50 × 0.25 m (114 kN), 0.38 × 0.20 m (68 kN), 0.15 × 0.20 m (27 kN) per Table 2 (transverse × longitudinal). 2.30 m transverse occupancy = 1.80 m gauge + 0.50 m contact.

vehicles.name: IRC Class 70R wheeled vehicle
vehicles.notes: 7-axle wheeled vehicle, total 1000 kN. Axle loads 80/120/120/170/170/170/170 kN at 3.96/1.52/2.13/1.37/3.05/1.37 m (13.40 m axle train; IRC figure overall length ≈ 15.4 m). Verified 2.90 m transverse occupancy. Transverse contact spread 0.84 m per side and 0.25 m longitudinal contact are nominal footprint values used for drawing and clearance geometry only — verify contact patch against your project specification.

vehicles.name: IRC Class 70R tracked vehicle
vehicles.datumDescription: Front edge of track contact area, vehicle centreline
vehicles.notes: Tracked vehicle, total 700 kN (350 kN per track). Contact length 4.57 m, track width 0.84 m, track centres 2.06 m (2.90 m transverse occupancy). Overall vehicle length 7.92 m; only the 4.57 m contact area carries load. Track load is discretised into longitudinal slices for generation and load transfer.

vehicles.name: IRC Class 70R bogie (400 kN)
vehicles.notes: 40 t bogie: two axles at 1.22 m centres, 200 kN per axle (400 kN total). Footprint values are the same nominal spread used for the 70R wheeled vehicle. Commonly used for local deck-slab checks.
